source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Rear Suspension and Drive Line, p.4-18

procedures.title: Rear wheel spindle and support: remove, repair and install
steps: (continued) Fit the outer bearing with its large end toward the spindle shoulder.
Press the bearing on with a bearing spacer and J-9436 as installers (see figure 43 in the manual).
Pack the inner bearing with high-melting-point wheel bearing grease and set it in the support, small end facing in.
Tap a new inner grease seal into its bore and fit the deflector over the inner end of the support.
Installation: put the support over the torque arm bolts with the strut rod fork pointing inboard and down; fit the backing plate over the studs and torque the nuts to specification.
Reconnect the parking brake cable to the actuating lever.
Install the drive spindle as described under Wheel Bearing Adjustment.
If a new support or related parts were fitted, assemble the spindle to the support with a .145" shim, then check end play and correct as in the adjustment procedure.

procedures.title: Differential carrier support bracket: replace
steps: Put a 1/2" thick wood or steel block between the carrier nose and the floor pan so the carrier cannot twist up when the bracket is freed.
Remove the bolt holding the carrier support to the crossmember.
Remove the nuts from both bracket-to-carrier through bolts and pull the bolts.
Reassemble in reverse order and torque all bolts to specification.

procedures.title: Rear shock absorber: remove and install
steps: Removal: disconnect the shock absorber upper mounting bolt (see figure 44 in the manual).
